name: No Content
meaning: Request succeeded without a response body
fix_hint: Do not send a response body

name: Bad Request
typical_fastapi_cause: Custom request validation or business rule failed
fix_hint: Check the request and validation logic

name: Not Found
typical_fastapi_cause: Unknown route or HTTPException for a missing record
fix_hint: Check the URL or record ID

name: Method Not Allowed
meaning: HTTP method is unsupported for this path
typical_fastapi_cause: Using POST on a GET-only endpoint

name: Unprocessable Content
typical_fastapi_cause: FastAPI or Pydantic request validation failed
fix_hint: Check required fields and data types

name: Too Many Requests
typical_fastapi_cause: Rate limiting middleware or upstream service rejected requests

name: Internal Server Error
fix_hint: Inspect server logs and fix the exception

name: Service Unavailable
fix_hint: Check service health and retry later
